title: FilmCraft project (.fcproj)
description: UTF-8 JSON written by filmcraft-format, schema_version 15 (FilmCraft 0.15). Media is referenced by path, never embedded. Files are compact. Ticks: 254016000000 per second. A null coordinate of a point parameter is NaN (auto). This schema lists every field the 0.15 model reads; fields with serde default may be omitted. Unknown future fields are allowed on the envelope and project so a newer optional key does not fail a reader that only checks this file.

schema_version.description: This build writes 15 and reads 1..15. Newer files are refused.

view.description: Optional. Not part of the edit, not an undo step. Omitted when nothing is open.

tick.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

x.description: null is NaN, meaning auto (frame or source centre) on point parameters only

frameRate.description: Exact frames per second, num/den. Defaults: 24000/1001.

time.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

keyframes.description: Clip-relative ticks. Empty or omitted = static. Default empty.

time.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

items.description: Map of decimal item id (string key) to item. Ids are u64.

next_id.description: Next id handed out. Must be greater than every id in use. Default for a new project: 1.

transcripts.description: Media item id -> transcript. Default empty, omitted when empty.

search_bins.description: Schema v11. Default empty, omitted when empty.

source_graphics.description: Schema v12. Default empty, omitted when empty.

narrations.description: Schema v14. Default empty, omitted when empty.

default_still_duration.description: 5 seconds. The editor uses the Timeline preference instead.

default_audio_transition_duration.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

ingest.description: Default: enabled false, action createProxies, destination null, preset empty.

rate.description: Exact frames per second, num/den. Defaults: 24000/1001.

duration.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

rate.description: Exact frames per second, num/den. Defaults: 24000/1001.

offline.description: Made offline on purpose. A missing file is detected at runtime and is not stored.

identity.description: Optional. Omitted for generators and projects from before schema 6. Hex fingerprint of size + first MiB + last MiB.

duration.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

audio_streams.description: Schema v13. Older files used a single `audio` object or null; both load as this array. Stream 0 is the primary stream.

start_timecode.description: First frame, in frames at video.frame_rate.

frame_rate.description: Exact frames per second, num/den. Defaults: 24000/1001.

par.description: Pixel aspect, numerator then denominator. Square is [1, 1].

anyOf.description: Exact frames per second, num/den. Defaults: 24000/1001.

start_timecode.description: Frames. 0 is the default for a new sequence.

multicam.description: Schema v8. Omitted when the sequence is not a multi-camera source.

merged.description: Schema v8. Omitted unless this sequence is a merged clip.

frame_rate.description: Exact frames per second, num/den. Defaults: 24000/1001.

name.description: Engine names are `Video N` and `Audio N`. Commands also accept V1 / A1.

enabled.description: Video: eye. Audio: not muted by the eye toggle.

label.description: Optional. Omitted when the track has no colour.

trackItem.description: A clip on a track. start/duration are sequence ticks. source_in is media time. Items on one track do not overlap.

start.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

duration.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

source_in.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

speed.description: 1.0 = 100%. Negative means reverse; `reverse` is the flag the editor uses.

link.description: Shared link id of the video/audio partners.

gain_db.description: Clip gain, separate from the Volume effect.

essential.description: Essential Sound. Optional. kind is Dialogue|Music|SFX|Ambience.

source_channels.description: Audio source channels, 0-based. Omitted when empty (first two channels).

start.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

duration.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

from.description: Outgoing clip. Null = fade in from nothing.

to.description: Incoming clip. Null = fade out to nothing.

effect.description: Stable effect id. See effectCatalog. Video clips carry intrinsic motion, opacity and time_remap. Audio clips carry volume, channel_volume and panner. Text is graphic_text. Shapes are graphic_shape.

effectCatalog.description: Every effect and transition id registered in FilmCraft 0.15. Not a constraint: a project may name an id the renderer does not implement, and the file still opens.

textStyle.description: graphic_text parameters (Effect Controls). Choice indexes: align Left=0 Center=1 Right=2 Justify=3; caps Normal=0 All Caps=1 Small Caps=2; fill_kind Solid=0 Linear Gradient=1; stroke type Outer=0 Center=1 Inner=2. Defaults in parentheses.

maskPath.description: Closed cubic Bezier in clip pixels. Vertices are {p, t_in, t_out} with Vec2 points.

start.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

duration.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

start.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

duration.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

text.description: Lines separated by newline. <i>/<b>/<u> and WebVTT voice spans are kept.

captionStyle.description: Track style. All fields default: font Inter, size 54, color white, background on, background_color [0,0,0,191], align Center, anchor Bottom, margin 0.08, line_spacing 1.25, outline 0, outline_color black, font_style SemiBold.

mixer.description: Default: mode Read, lanes omitted, sends omitted, output null, record_arm false, solo_safe false, input_map Stereo.

lanes.description: Keys: volume, pan, mute, send.<i>.level, pan51.x, pan51.y, pan51.center, pan51.lfe. Keyframe time is sequence time.

start.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

duration.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

splitMarks.description: camelCase. Omitted when every side is empty.

preroll.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

ease_in.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

ease_out.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

postroll.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

intro.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

outro.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

design_in.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

design_duration.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

graphicMeta.description: Schema v12. Optional on the clip.

items.description: start/end character indexes plus camelCase CharStyle overrides (font, fontStyle, size, fill, fauxBold, fauxItalic, underline, strikethrough, tracking, baselineShift, caps).

layerExtra.description: Schema v12, on graphic layers. Omitted when empty.

additionalProperties.description: Time in ticks. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second. serde transparent i64.

clipKinds.description: Item kinds that can sit on a timeline: Media (movie, audio, still, image sequence, synthetic), Sequence (nest), Subclip, AdjustmentLayer, Graphic (text and shapes live on the clip as effects).
